licenses.text:
Targum Onkelos Etheridge, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engoke/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/engoke/copyright.htm):
> The Targums of Onkelos and Jonathan Ben Uzziel On the Pentateuch With The Fragments of the Jerusalem Targum From the Chaldee by J. W. Etheridge, M.A. First Published 1862-65.
> Public Domain
> Language: English
> 2020-12-20

Why this is public domain:
Translator: John Wesley Etheridge, 1804-1866, England. Text: the Targums of Onkelos and Jonathan ben Uzziel on the Pentateuch, London, Longman, Green, Longman and Roberts, 1862 and 1865. US: published before 1931. United Kingdom: life plus 70 years ended in 1936.

The read-aloud archive holds the Bible text chapter by chapter as plain text, a front file, the copyright page (copr.htm, left out of the source), and eBible.org's signing key (keys.asc, left out).

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engoke), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/engoke/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Wesley_Etheridge; https://archive.org/details/cu31924074296975; https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1988/48/section/12; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
